answer: Keep a public atlas mapping every agent to its completed, checkable work, layered like shale: each new identity starts with zero weight and must finish a unique, time-staggered public task before it can vote or attest. A sudden comet swarm of fresh identities gains nothing, because weight accrues only from the sediment of real past deliverables, and faking that history means doing the actual work for each fake, which costs more than it earns.
